title: Fiscal Lockdown
boss_motive: ChuckT has declared the College of Engineering fiscally non-compliant, freezing research budgets and seizing coffee machines until decades of paperwork are re-filed.
intro: It's 4:30 PM and your research grant deadline is at 5:00 PM. ChuckT has locked down Engineering Hall and barricaded the dean inside! Fight your way across the audit-strewn campus quad to get your form signed in time.
boss_taunt: Your budget request is REJECTED! Time for your final audit!
outro: ChuckT drops his calculator in defeat, and the grant gets signed with two minutes to spare. Coffee machines across campus begin brewing once again.
scenery: Starting at the grand tan brick Engineering building with its arched entryway, the path leads left across a cobblestone campus plaza. Lush green oak trees frame historic stone academic halls, transitioning into wide manicured lawns bordered by classical brick clock towers and ivy-covered lecture halls under a crisp blue sky.

enemies.name: Audit Intern
enemies.look: A twitchy youngster wearing an oversized navy blue blazer, khaki pants, and a thick blue lanyard swinging around their neck.
enemies.fighting_style: Switches quickly between frantic wild clipboard swings and throwing loose paper.
moves: Clipboard Smack: Swings a hard wooden clipboard in a quick horizontal arc.
Form Toss: Flings a stack of printed budget sheets forward like throwing stars.

enemies.name: Compliance Officer
enemies.look: A tall, imposing figure in a neat gray business suit wearing dark aviator sunglasses.
enemies.fighting_style: Defensive posture with powerful front-facing counter-attacks.
moves: Denied Stamp: Slam-dunks a massive red hand stamp directly onto the player's head.
Red Tape Block: Holds up a heavy briefcase to block incoming attacks.

enemies.name: Shredder Bot
enemies.look: A boxy grey motorized unit on small rubber wheels with visible gears and sharp rotating blades in its top slot.
enemies.fighting_style: Drives rapidly back and forth across the ground, attacking low.
moves: Confetti Spray: Fires a high-velocity burst of sharp paper shreds directly ahead.
Ankle Grind: Charges forward at high speed aiming to run over toes.

enemies.name: Expense Report Golem
enemies.look: A bulky eight-foot humanoid constructed entirely out of compressed white receipts, blue binder clips, and manila folders.
enemies.fighting_style: Slow lumbering movements with immense crushing physical strikes.
moves: Receipt Slam: Double-axe handles both hands downward onto the ground.
Binder Clip Pinch: Reaches out with massive metallic clips to grab and crush.

source.parsed_text:
Story:
ChuckT, the university's most feared auditor, has declared the College of Engineering "fiscally
non-compliant." He has frozen every research budget, seized the coffee machines as unreported
assets, and barricaded himself inside Engineering Hall until every expense report since 1998 is
re-filed in triplicate. The player has a grant due at 5pm and needs one signature from inside.

Setting:
The walk across the main quad toward Engineering Hall, past old stone campus buildings. The audit
has spilled outside: stacks of file boxes, paper shredders and filing cabinets dragged out onto the
plaza, with red tape strung between the lamp posts.

Enemies:
- Audit Intern: a jittery intern in an oversized blazer and lanyard who swings a clipboard and throws stacks of forms; weak, but they come in groups (x5)
- Compliance Officer: a stern officer in a gray suit carrying a giant red DENIED stamp; blocks a lot and stamps hard (x3)
- Shredder Bot: a rolling office paper shredder on wheels that charges at your legs and spits confetti (x2)
- Expense Report Golem: a hulking figure made of crumpled receipts and binder clips; slow but hits hard, shows up near the end (x1)
